purpose: Document local registry evidence and public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Official municipal natural-resources and immovable-property registration responsibilities and city-level registration policy were found. Jinhua’s official open-data portal was reviewed for spatial datasets; no public parcel feature schema or bounded geometry service was established. The WUP point was not matched to a district/street parcel; no owner or property query was made.
registryAssessment: Jinhua’s official city natural-resources and planning authority is assigned natural-resource and immovable-property title registration responsibilities; Jinhua government bulletins document city-level immovable-property registration rules. These establish a local registry custodian, not open parcel-vector coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official 2025 Jinhua government bulletin issued by the city Natural Resources and Planning Bureau records city-level immovable-property registration policy.

Official 2025 budget of the Jinhua Economic Development Zone bureau branch describes natural-resource investigation and immovable-property title-registration duties; it is subdistrict evidence, not a city parcel layer.
Official Jinhua municipal open-data portal reviewed; no public cadastral parcel vector dataset/schema was found in the reviewed results.
Official city bureau domain; direct open timed out, so no feature-service claim is based on it.
